topics.topic: Behavior when a service has no selected instance (ManifestOperation materialization, base_url presence, and refusal classification)
questions: When no instance is selected, is `base_url` also absent, and is a ManifestOperation still materialized for proposal/invocation checks?
For propose/accept binding on a service with no selected instance, is this a distinct refusal condition or treated as "manifest mismatch"?

quotes:
- State 2: what "manifest mismatch" is when a binding is proposed and invoked —
  closed by A08.
judgement.why: The refusal classification question is explicitly deferred to State 2 (A08), while State 1 already fixes that services without a selected instance are not invocable and proposal/acceptance are refused.

topics.topic: Unambiguous identity/reference scheme for a specific FlowActivation record
questions: What concrete persisted identifier or ordering fact names one specific activation record so other models/actions can reference it unambiguously?
What concrete field(s) identify a FlowActivation record when EffectAttempt stores authority, since M18 defines no explicit activation id field?

quotes:
The authority is named by its identity: an
  approval or a grant by its minted id, a flow activation by its position in
  the store's order (M18), so a version activated again never makes the
  reference ambiguous;

Read when a run starts
and when a standing grant is checked. A flow's active version is the one recorded
last (K-17); a new activation replaces the previous one at once, and runs already
started keep the version they pinned.
judgement.why: The texts explicitly define the reference scheme for FlowActivation as its position in the single-writer store order.

topics.topic: Canonical equality rule for model identifiers (case sensitivity and Unicode normalization)
questions: What exact equality rule is used for these names (case sensitivity and Unicode normalization), i.e., when are two names considered the same?

topics.topic: Deterministic persisted ordering/tie-break rule for choosing the current/last record
questions: What exact persisted ordering rule determines "last" for creation/activation records when timestamps collide or are equal-resolution?

topics.topic: Exact definition of "recent" for repair traces/trial evidence
questions: What defines "recent" for traces and trial evidence returned to the agent (time window, count limit, or all records)?

topics.topic: How repair scope is determined and which implementation bodies become readable to the agent
questions: Which product action and parameters determine that an agent is in "repair" scope, and exactly which implementation bodies become readable (only current of one slot, or more)?

topics.topic: Identity key for EffectApproval uniqueness/reuse (what counts as "its element")
questions: What exact identity defines "its element" for approval uniqueness and reuse?

topics.topic: Required EffectAttempt state transition after crash/restart when attempt is in_flight
questions: If the kernel restarts with an EffectAttempt still in_flight, what mandatory transition happens (and by whom) before the run can continue or the owner can resolve it?

topics.topic: Token/config change hot-reload scope, including whether owner_token updates apply without restart
questions: When installation auth config changes, is live reload limited to agent tokens or does owner_token also take effect without restart?

topics.topic: What an agent can see in approval preview when request data includes personal data
questions: If the built HTTP request (URL/headers/body) contains personal data, what exactly is returned to an agent reading the approval preview?
